title: Look & Feel / photographic comparisons
slide_intent: Show the boundary between natural and artificial treatments so image selection can be judged consistently.
strategic_value: Specific paired examples can protect DB’s photographic credibility across commissions.
demonstration: Six positive/negative pairs compare color, lighting, facial shadows, interaction, work portrayal and vehicle dynamics.
practical_value: Use the pairs to reject effect-led or staged imagery while retaining genuine people, movement and places.

content_islands.name: Look summary
content_islands.spec: Restate natural directional light and neutral color above the comparisons.

content_islands.name: Light and color pairs
content_islands.spec: Compare neutral color, directed light and legible faces with warm casts, extreme backlight and distracting shadow.

content_islands.name: Authenticity pairs
content_islands.spec: Compare real interaction, work and movement with staged poses, stock-like workers and exaggerated renderings.

reference_purposes.Application: Six paired photographs provide explicit image-selection comparisons.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source rejects overly warm color, cinematic light, face-obscuring shadows, posed interactions, generic stock-worker aesthetics and exaggerated rendering or speed effects.
